content: At SoAd_IfSpecificRoutingGroupTransmit() SoAd shall store a trigger transmit request for each SoAdPduRouteDest that contains a reference to the routing group identified by the parameter id for transmission on the socket connection identified by the parameter SoConId in the SoAd_MainFunction( ) .
